sentences.l1: Plastic is a kind of material.
It is very hard to disappear.

sentences.l2: 有一种新塑料，它能慢慢变小，最后不见。
sentences.l1: There is a new kind of plastic that can slowly get smaller and finally disappear.

sentences.l2: 科学家在研究这种塑料。
大自然里的小生物，如细菌，可以吃这种塑料。
sentences.l1: Small living things in nature, such as bacteria, can eat this plastic.

sentences.l2: 它们把塑料分成很小的部分。
sentences.l1: They break the plastic into very small parts.

sentences.l2: 这样，塑料就不会伤害环境。
sentences.l1: This way, the plastic will not harm the environment.

sentences.l2: 这种材料是聚合物做的。
sentences.l1: This material is made of polymers.

sentences.l2: 聚合物是一种特别的材料。
sentences.l1: A polymer is a special kind of material.
It can be broken down by microorganisms.
